parsed_json.up: Select exact IC50 activity rows for CHEMBL1865. Join activities to assays on assay_id, filter by assay_chembl_id = 'CHEMBL1865' and standard_type = 'IC50'. Join to docs on doc_id, keep only rows where pubmed_id IS NOT NULL. Join to compound_records on record_id to get compound_key. Join to molecule_dictionary on molregno and require canonical_smiles via INNER JOIN to compound_structures. Join to target_dictionary on assays.tid. Return compound_chembl_id, canonical_smiles, compound_key, pubmed_id_or_doi (prefer pubmed_id, fallback to doi), assay_description, standard_type, standard_relation, standard_value, standard_units, activity_comment, target_chembl_id, target_name, and target_organism. Do not deduplicate; keep all qualifying activity rows. Sort by compound_chembl_id, canonical_smiles, compound_key, pubmed_id_or_doi, assay_description, standard_type, standard_relation, standard_value, standard_units, activity_comment, target_chembl_id, target_name, target_organism.
